name: The False Sun
storyline: You return to your grandfather’s farm with no clear memory of the time you once spent there. The village remembers you. And so does Silas — your childhood friend, whom you can’t remember, even though he seems to know you far too well.
summary: The False Sun is a first-person visual novel about a summer spent in a small village, where warm days, quiet fields, and familiar faces slowly give way to something far more unsettling.
